outcome.newOfficialEvidence: The current official overview calls 612 seats the basic shape but publishes two operational stage forms with capacity ranges: proscenium 540-600 and open 513-540. It explicitly permits removal of seats at the forestage and flat-floor areas for stage/orchestra-pit use and partial removal for three actor entrances. It states four wheelchair positions correspond to 12 seats but does not publish their individual numbers. An official performance page separately sells annotated seats, auxiliary chairs, and first-/third-floor standing positions when available.
outcome.currentness: The main theatre is officially closed from 2026-04-01 through 2027-03-31 (planned) for ceiling and stage-equipment renovation. The official numbered map currently linked from the venue page is dated April 2010; no post-renovation current numbered map or conversion schedule is published.
outcome.blocker: The issuer does not designate one default operational form/count, map the 12 wheelchair-conversion seats or other removable seats to individual numbers, or publish a post-renovation current numbered map. Selecting 612 or a range maximum would create repository policy and arithmetic fitting.
